session-data-anatomy.title: Four parts, four questions
session-data-anatomy.description: A session record holds prompts, responses, tools used and file changes. Where it runs, where it is stored, whether it syncs and who can access it are separate questions.

where-sessions-run.title: Where a session runs and what persists
where-sessions-run.description: Local, cloud sandbox and GitHub Actions sessions differ in whether the working environment persists, where the record lives and whether it is shared by default.

cli-session-directory.title: Inside the CLI configuration directory
cli-session-directory.description: The configuration directory holds the full session record, a rebuildable SQLite store, process logs and command history, each with a documented deletion risk.

local-store-maintenance.title: Prune, delete and reindex local sessions
local-store-maintenance.description: Check storage, prune by age or delete by ID with a preview, then reindex if session folders were removed by hand. Local commands never remove synced copies.

sync-controls.title: Does a local CLI session sync?
sync-controls.description: With the policy allowing sync, a run flag decides first, then the remoteExport setting; by default the session syncs to the personal account and stays private.

sync-policy-access.title: Availability is not access
sync-policy-access.description: Administrators decide whether local sessions can sync. Users own synced sessions and choose what to share. Collaborators see only what is shared, view-only.

share-visibility.title: What sharing grants
share-visibility.description: Actions cloud agent sessions are shared by default; sandbox and synced local sessions are shared only on request. Recipients can view but cannot steer or query them.

export-formats.title: Share targets and standalone copies
export-formats.description: Links and gists stay on GitHub and can be revoked or deleted there. Markdown, HTML, JSON and copied text are standalone copies that you must manage separately.

delete-archive-hide.title: Which removal control works where
delete-archive-hide.description: Share, delete and archive availability by session type and surface. Cloud agent sessions on GitHub Actions can be archived but not deleted.

retention-windows.title: Documented retention windows
retention-windows.description: GitHub.com Chat messages are deleted after 28 days and audit events after 180 days. Synced and local session records have no documented expiry and stay until deleted.

session-vs-audit-log.title: Session record or audit event?
session-vs-audit-log.description: Session records hold content and belong to the user; audit events record actions for administrators. The agent session ID connects an event to its session.

evidence-tracing.title: Trace one agent change
evidence-tracing.description: A cloud agent commit links to its session log, and the audit event carries the same agent session ID. Access rules and retention limits shape each hop.
